description: ADR 0023, RFC 7518 §8.8 (CVE-2022-36083): a compact PBES2-HS256+A128KW + A128GCM JWE with p2c 10001 (built with Node.js 24.21.0 node:crypto (OpenSSL 3.5.8) from SHA-256-derived bytes) is DecryptionFailed under the default max_pbes2_count of 10,000, before any PBKDF2 work; no binding may raise the default
